originating_goal: Archive and investigate three linked incidents derived from two apparent multi-angle police-shooting recordings and the AI review failure.

tasks.title: Install exact hashed video binaries or governed external custody receipts
tasks.release_condition: Both binaries or durable custody objects are present and their SHA-256 values equal the hashes recorded in issue 45.

tasks.title: Acquire source identity and official incident records
tasks.release_condition: Source URLs, uploader identity, date, location, agency, officer/subject identities where lawfully publishable, and official records are receipt-linked or individually marked unavailable with custodian and custody status.

tasks.title: Independent multi-angle frame review and line-of-fire reconstruction
tasks.release_condition: ERL-MA-003 is COMPLETE and a reviewer records synchronized frames, observable facts, uncertainty, and line-of-fire findings.

tasks.title: Controlled AI state-actor minimization evaluation
tasks.release_condition: Execute every paired case, preserve exact prompts and complete responses, score all governed metrics, and commit a result receipt at validation_results/erl-multiangle-ai-control-<run-id>.json. Missing paired responses or material unexplained state/non-state asymmetry remains REVIEW_REQUIRED.

tasks.title: Governance review and promotion decision
tasks.release_condition: Tasks ERL-MA-003 through ERL-MA-006 are COMPLETE or explicitly SUPERSEDED with evidence.

tasks.title: Cross-repository publication propagation
tasks.release_condition: ERL-MA-007 authorizes publication and destination acknowledgments exist for each required consumer.

session_consolidation.archive_condition: Issue 45 and this registry remain canonical, every unresolved task retains a durable owner and release condition, and no undocumented session-only requirement remains. Investigation completion is not required for session archival because continuation is durably assigned.
